# Krystle Cole Fine Art

> A fine art studio specializing in custom pet portraits, animal art prints, and original paintings across multiple mediums and styles.

Krystle Cole is an accomplished artist with 15 years of painting experience, offering both custom commissioned work and a curated collection of original paintings and art prints. The studio features animal-focused art ranging from pet portraits to surreal landscapes, with products including fine art prints, stickers, postcards, and original paintings.

## Key Topics

- Custom pet portraits
- Fine art prints
- Original paintings
- Animal art
- Acrylic painting
- Cat art prints
- Dog prints
- Surreal landscapes
- Hand-painted portraits
- Woodland animals
- Contemporary art
- Art supplies
- Samadhi Collection
- Sedgwick County Zoo
- Home décor
